svg.title: Nilam end-to-end system architecture
svg.desc: A wide architecture diagram showing Nilam land suitability, the ArchAI2 house generation extension, the Kerala construction cost calculator, their data sources, models, runtime flow, outputs, and offline training pipeline.
svg.text: Kerala land intelligence → AI-assisted house design → district-aware construction budget
LOCAL-FIRST PRODUCT · CLOUD DATA ON DEMAND
Where to inspect and what the user needs
Site evidence, hard screening, prediction and explanation
Concept budget from the saved design
• Search, click, polygon or device location
• Centre point + radius for land discovery
• Optional text or English voice preferences
Google Maps, Places and Street View
Build 38 mapped terrain, climate, soil, water, hazard, access, utility and amenity features.
For radius search, sample fresh grid cells and reject steep, rough, flooded, built-up or building-adjacent cells.
Hard safety/open-land gates → calibrated class-probability fusion → ordinal suitability percentage
Conditional permutation SHAP explains the final result; amenity and evidence services add local context.
Final score + suitability band · feature drivers · ranked flat/open candidates · amenities · Street View
Converts the user’s brief and refinements into schema-constrained house requirements.
Language interpretation only; geometry must pass deterministic validation.
Rejects collisions and infeasible geometry; checks access, circulation, room area, adjacency and setbacks.
Only validated structured geometry can become the saved revision.
One continuous Nilam journey, with each output feeding the next decision
Suitability percentage · evidence drivers · SHAP explanation
Nearby amenities · Street View · saved location
Ranked flat/open candidate points within the chosen radius
Preference match · site detail · Street View inspection
Validated 2D floor plan · interactive 3D model · revision history
SVG / PNG / PDF / GLB / GLTF exports
Kerala district-adjusted planning budget and range
Transparent quantities, assumptions, exclusions and source links
Executed ahead of runtime; produces versioned data and model artifacts loaded by the land service
GSI / KSDMA / UNEP hazards · Kerala OSM PBF
Fine-tune TerraMind vision head + final two encoder blocks
Accuracy · macro F1 · precision · recall · log loss
Runtime: React + Google Maps UI · Nilam FastAPI (:8000) · ArchAI2 FastAPI (:8001) · Next.js workspace (:3000) · local SQLite + caches
